build_TridentFasterRCNN: build a TridentFasterRCNN detector with backbone, rpn_head, roi_head, train_cfg, and test_cfg config
run_TridentFasterRCNN_forward: run the TridentFasterRCNN forward pass on batch inputs with multi-branch data samples
run_TridentFasterRCNN_loss: run the TridentFasterRCNN loss computation on batch inputs with multi-branch data samples
run_TridentFasterRCNN_predict: run the TridentFasterRCNN predict method on batch inputs to get detection results
test_TridentFasterRCNN_aug_test: test the TridentFasterRCNN with augmented images and image metadata for inference
